About me

I turn briefs for admissions, scholarship tests and batch launches into layouts that work at every size, from a 300-pixel banner to a 55-foot hoarding. My work covers art direction, typography, photo compositing and print production, with AI-assisted workflows where they save time.

Before design I spent 14 months in sales at Henry Harvin Education and studied bioinformatics. Both taught me to start from the person reading the work.
